$Comment: The Headless Horseman on foot, once he is thrown from the saddle: a Variant of this pack's Hallows_Eve_Template_Horseman_Foot (the game's Gobliterator boss template, copied with his own sounds), with his look, his health, his longsword and his own combat evaluator (CAE_Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman: sword swings, a ringed slam, his dash, and the fire ward that halves the Fire he takes). The template is why his dash is telegraphed the Gobliterator's way: when the evaluator picks Charge he locks onto a player for half a second, then winds up for a full second, unstoppable, glowing with a warning marker ahead of him (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Dash_Glow) and crying out (his model's DashPrepare set), and charges 20 to 25 blocks straight through where they stood in a roar of flame; any block in his path stuns him for a second. A player he runs through takes CombatChargeHitEntityInteraction, the Burnt Praetorian's own charge hit. He only exists inside his fight: the fight's script swaps him in from Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Mounted, and his health carries across, so MaxHealth here must equal the mounted role's. The template keeps him unshoved, drops nothing (his reward is the Claims his fight pays) and has no leash, since the fight, not a leash, decides when he resets. Any key the template does not declare makes the game refuse the whole role.
